lockedMove.excerpt: theist okay let me try to just make a a quick uh summary of of of my arguments against what Dr PR has argued as far as theological argument it's a lot it's it's based on logic logic is based on uh the uh premises that you make it's only as good as the premises that you make otherwise it's of no value whatsoever in telling you anything about reality now this whole business of nothing I argue that uh that we have very good physical reason to understand how something can come from from nothing because there's a natural tendency in the universe and all
lockedMove.proposition: Logic is only as sound as its premises, while physical processes give reason to model complexity arising naturally from simpler states.
